boundary_evidence: WHOLE UNIT. tu_map calls 0x020ad660..0x020b2c58 one contiguous ov004 linker run labelled dScMgBase_c (build/tu_map.json, tools/tu_map.py). This TU licenses all 125 functions, ROM ordinals 0..124, as one complete .text claim.

LOWER EDGE: 0x020ad660 is the first byte of ov004's .text (config/arm9/overlays/ov004/delinks.txt), so nothing sits below it. The class evidence reaches that edge: dScMgBase_c::Virtual8C is the first function.

UPPER EDGE: the unit ends with _ZN11dScMgBase_cC2Ev (0x020b2adc, size 0x17c) plus its static-init tail __arraydtor$328/_ZN3EntD1Ev/_ZN3EntC1Ev, closing at 0x020b2c84. tu_map starts its next ov004 unit there (0x020b2c58..0x020b8714, 137 functions, no class label); the first three of that run were this unit's generated support functions, absorbed by the sinit fold.

WIDENED from the earlier 108-function claim 0x020ad660..0x020b2220. func_ov004_020b2220 (size 0x224), the one unmatched function that bounded it, byte-matched, and with it the run is one piece. 17 sources were folded: func_ov004_020b2220 and the 16 above it, func_ov004_020b2444 through the constructor, including slots 31 to 33 (Virtual7C, Virtual80, Virtual84), the four empty or trivial slots 18 to 21, the destructor and the constructor.

DESTRUCTOR ORDER. The cartridge has D2 at 0x020b29c0, D0 at 0x020b2a18 and D1 at 0x020b2a84, then C2. 64 ov006 relocations name D2 (descendants' base-subobject teardown) and the _ZTV11dScMgBase_c slots at 0x020bc100/0x020bc104 name D1 and D0, so the symbols.txt names are the right way round. Under defer_codegen off one out-of-line ~dScMgBase_c() emits D1, D0, D2; inside a defer_codegen on bracket, with the constructor written before it, mwccarm emits D2, D0, D1, C2 in cartridge order.

KEY FUNCTION. ~dScMgBase_c is the class's first declared virtual and is now defined here, so this TU emits _ZTV/_ZTI/_ZTS11dScMgBase_c and the ancestor RTTI chain (fBase_c, dBase_c, dScene_c) alongside graphCallback_c's records (GraphCallback0, 0x020ae0d4, is that class's key function). Each is a deadstrip-data row with its canonical symbols.txt home; ov004 .data stays ROM-owned, so the TU stays text-only. The homeless C1 and the vague-linkage _ZN8dScene_cD2Ev and _ZN7dBase_cD2Ev are deadstrip rows.

SOURCE ORDER IS ROM-ASCENDING, lowest address first, under #pragma defer_codegen off, except the deferred constructor/destructor bracket at the end described above; tubuild verify reports all 125 in ROM-ascending emission order. #pragma opt_strength_reduction off (func_ov004_020af5e0), opt_common_subs off (func_ov004_020ae858) and opt_propagation off (func_ov004_020b2220) are push/pop brackets around one function each.

notes: Generated by tools/tubuild.py create for the eight scene overrides, then widened by hand: first to 108 functions below func_ov004_020b2220, then, once that function matched, to the whole 125-function unit. Every folded one-function source was retired.

Declaration conflicts between the folded shards are resolved by keeping each former file's own declarations in a namespace named for its address (extern "C" inside, so every symbol keeps its unmangled ROM name). The shards disagree about the types of the same globals (data_ov004_020beb68, data_0209b308, data_0209d45c, data_ov004_020bebe8, ...) and about the layout of local structs (C, E, M, Obj, ...); merging them changes codegen. dScMgBase_c members are defined at global scope and pull in just their file's names with using-declarations.

func_ov004_020af5e0 keeps its shard's #pragma opt_strength_reduction off, func_ov004_020ae858 its #pragma opt_common_subs off and func_ov004_020b2220 its #pragma opt_propagation off, each in a push/pop bracket. FreeGfxSlotsById copies its argument into the loop counter before comparing (i = arg; if (i == 0x1d)): the shard's `i = arg == 0x1d` was C and under C++ materialises the comparison as a bool.

func_ov004_020b2220 matches through local static inline FX_Mul (with a named s64 product) and MTX_Rot22 helpers, the NitroSDK shapes; with the products written out in the body the thousands counter is allocated to ip or r3 instead of r0.
The D2 and D0 shards carried _MSC_VER arms giving the host the flat D2 and D0 names. They are kept as one #ifdef _MSC_VER block after the destructor; mwccarm never defines _MSC_VER.
The file-global #pragma opt_strength_reduction off the eight-member TU carried is gone: BeforeBehavior matches without it once the file is ROM-ascending under defer_codegen off.

Static-initializer fold: __sinit_ov004_020b948c retired; the unit now emits it from the static state -- the graphCallback_c registry object, the 0x40-entry Ent pool (__cxa_vec_ctor + __arraydtor$328 cleanup registration), and the two PMF state tables. func_ov004_020ae104 is the graphCallback_c complete-object ctor; func_ov004_020b2c58 is the array cleanup thunk; func_ov004_020b2c7c/020b2c80 are Ent's trivial dtor/ctor; the four state handlers memberized onto Ent.

Local scratch link built ROM sha256 ddab9300b24aeae254192c2a30d812b07ece3adff83230e75c865ed915c9de40, identical to this machine's stock control (EU ASMP dump; the divergent bytes are NDS container/packaging fields outside every module range). The recorded rom.sha256 is the fleet SHA every other intact entry shares. Module set, symbol inventory, and the five owned ranges matched.
